verdict.rationale: dlt documents automatic schema inference plus explicit 'schema evolution' handling and 'schema and data contracts' that let engineers adapt to upstream changes without breaking loads (dlt-docs-4, dlt-docs-20/36/54/65). Community commentary about wanting to disable automatic schema changes actually implies such control exists rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the specific contract policy modes (e.g., evolve/freeze/discard) and independent hands-on validation of policy enforcement in production.
